_task: Q78 - judo and sambo escapes and defences that do not exist
_note: Draft nodes for S1f. Every source is labelled SOURCED: or INFERENCE:. No defense_answers key answers submission today, so the sambo leg-lock escape is an escape node, not a defense node.

judo.name: Kesa-gatame Escape (Scarf Hold Break)
judo.source: INFERENCE: Kodokan newaza curriculum teaches bridging and turning toward uke's head to escape kesa-gatame; Q72_judo_seats.json line 8 confirms judo_kesagatame as ground_top pin.

judo.name: Yoko-shiho-gatame Escape (Side Control Break)
judo.source: INFERENCE: frame-and-shrimp escape from side four-quarter hold; Q72_judo_seats.json line 44 confirms judo_yokoshihogatame as ground_top pin.

judo.name: Kami-shiho-gatame Escape (North-South Break)
judo.source: INFERENCE: bridge-and-roll escape from north-south; harder than side control because uke's weight is centred on the torso. Q72_judo_seats.json line 32 confirms judo_kamishihogatame as ground_top pin.

judo.name: Tate-shiho-gatame Escape (Mount Break)
judo.source: INFERENCE: upa bridge escape from mount (vertical four-quarter hold); Q72_judo_seats.json line 50 confirms judo_tateshihogatame as ground_top pin.

judo.name: Taisabaki (Body Evasion from Throws)
judo.source: INFERENCE: taisabaki (body management) is the foundational judo movement for avoiding throws by moving off the line of attack; not currently catalogued as a standalone defense node. takedown_defense answers incoming takedown; evasion answers incoming strike per defense_answers.

judo.name: Kumi-kata Defense (Grip Fighting)
judo.source: INFERENCE: grip fighting defense prevents opponent from establishing the kumi-kata needed to set up throws; builds on judo_kumikata. takedown_defense answers incoming takedown; scramble answers takedown and control per defense_answers.

sambo.name: Bridge Escape from Pin
sambo.source: INFERENCE: basic wrestling-influenced bridge escape from a sambo pin; sambo_fias_sport ruleset lists hold_downs as legal (competition_rulesets_v2.json, sambo_fias_sport.legal_techniques).

sambo.name: Frame and Roll from Pin
sambo.source: INFERENCE: frame against the pinning opponent's near-side arm or shoulder, then roll to recover position; sambo's ground game draws from both judo newaza and wrestling.

sambo.name: Leg Lock Entry Escape

flags.note: Modeled as escape, not defense: no defense_answers key answers submission today. See report SUBMISSION section.

sambo.source: INFERENCE: escape from straight ankle lock or kneebar entry; sambo_fias_sport ruleset lists painful_holds_joint_locks as legal (competition_rulesets_v2.json, sambo_fias_sport.legal_techniques). Handled as escape node because no defense_answers key answers the submission class.

sambo.name: Hip Escape (Shrimp) from Pin
sambo.source: INFERENCE: hip escape common to all grappling arts; sambo's ground curriculum includes it as a fundamental movement. Follows the bjj_shrimp_escape pattern (escape + guard_recovery).

sambo.name: Throw Defense (Anti-Throw Base)
sambo.source: INFERENCE: sambo's throw defense draws from judo and wrestling; dropping the hips and maintaining a low centre of gravity. takedown_defense and throw_damage_reduction both answer incoming takedown per defense_answers.

sambo.name: Grip Break Defense
sambo.source: INFERENCE: breaking the opponent's grip to prevent throw setups; sambo's jacket grappling demands grip fighting analogous to judo kumi-kata. takedown_defense answers takedown; scramble answers takedown and control per defense_answers.
